audio.title: Apollo 11 Mission Audio - Day 5 (NASA)
audio.method: Edited NASA highlights reel. Each segment is pinned to mission time by matching the reel's speech-recognition captions to the NASA air-to-ground transcript. Accuracy is a few seconds.

segments.note: Houston, Eagle. How do you read?
Eagle, Houston. We read you now. You're GO for PDI. Over.
Same alarm, and it appears to come up when we have a 1668 up.
Roger. 1201 alarm. We're GO. Same type. We're GO.
Okay. It looks like we're venting the oxidizer now.

video.title: Apollo 11 16 mm onboard film: lunar landing (NASA JSC)
video.method: Shot through Aldrin's window by the 16 mm data acquisition camera at 6 frames per second and transferred at 30, so it runs five times faster than life. Pinned to mission time at touchdown, when the LM's shadow stops moving (102:45:40); the yaw to windows-up, which takes the surface out of view, falls within the documented manoeuvre.

segments.note: descent and landing, five times speed
